Legacy St29 validates skill/used-skill/target/melee range, allocates a combat record even on a miss, and applies enhanced physical damage plus elemental roll only on successful hit.
Legacy AllocCombat fills remaining damage and calls CalculateTotalDamage before storing the record. Do64 therefore reads the prepared physical channel, not an unmitigated weapon roll.

Do64 caps prepared physical by target current FP life, takes the integer percentage, then invokes self ExecuteEvents with hit flag0x1000, self ExecuteMissileDamage, and finally DrainItemDurability in that order.

DrainItemDurability re-fetches the combat record, checks melee range and attacker mode, then invokes target ExecuteEvents. Self death, combat record removal and motion must be traced rather than committing target damage unconditionally.

ExecuteEvents applies absorb-life healing later, immediately before direct life subtraction; the current MitigatePrepared helper heals absorb immediately. Sacrifice needs an explicit prepare/commit boundary to preserve the target-life cap and self-before-target ordering.
